Inclusion Criteria:
  -  histologically proven advanced esophageal cancer
  -  excluded from curative therapy because of disease stage  [OR] and/or presence of multiple comorbidities  [OR] and/or poor performance status
  -  age > 18 years
  -  Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) <3
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  prior radiotherapy to the same region
